edits.new: (SELECT count(DISTINCT orw.role_id) FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization w LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker orw ON w.worker_id=orw.organization_worker_code AND w.source_relation=orw.source_relation WHERE w.organization_id=ow.organization_id AND w.source_relation='workday') unique_organization_roles
